purpose: Map every active entry in the two supplied SPFE error files to a proposed owner and safe next action, preserving source classification and all duplicate occurrences.
status: proposed review mapping; complete supplied-entry coverage; runtime and API bindings unqualified
source_decoding: Error-file bytes read as ISO-8859-1; raw property values, Unicode escapes and placeholders preserved. BG/BT files read as UTF-8-compatible bytes.
limits: Source category is the original file classification. It does not establish customer fault, retry permission, severity or response level.
Handling groups, English messages and accountable roles are proposed Sage controls. Group names are not API enums or deployed field names.
Each entry uses its source ID and line as identity. Do not key this inventory only by property_key or apply last-value-wins to duplicates.
A property key or rule token is not an established wire code. All per-entry operation, response field, HTTP status, severity and API-code bindings remain unqualified.
Semantic correspondences preserve observed response bindings separately and do not activate a template lookup.
Term paths are exact lookups for explicit source BT/BG mentions. They are not validated XPath, payload locations or a completed DTS mapping.
Never select automatic replay or a lifecycle transition from the file category, numeric prefix or proposed handling group. Apply PCN-09 to transmission and original-outcome evidence.
Unknown or ambiguous entries retain their raw evidence and an owned review action. Do not display raw parameters or paths without safe wording and access checks.
Country-specific rules and catalogue selection remain Spain-scoped. Qualify shared error presentation/correlation patterns and existing DTS before claiming implementation reuse.

invoice_validation.label: Invoice content and tax rules

invoice_validation.proposed_next_action: Check the reported invoice facts, conditions, amounts and tax treatment. If facts are correct, investigate the mapping or selected rule pack. Preserve issued bytes.
invoice_validation.repeat_condition: After an authorised correction and revalidation. For an issued invoice, use its approved correction process; establish any earlier external outcome under PCN-09 first.
invoice_validation.proposed_customer_message_en: Check the invoice details identified in the validation result.

identity_data.label: Business-party identity
identity_data.responsible_role: Customer/accountant; Integration and Identity if source facts are correct
identity_data.proposed_next_action: Check the reported party and identity scheme against source facts. Keep seller, buyer, represented party and authenticated caller distinct.
identity_data.repeat_condition: After an authorised correction and revalidation. For an issued invoice, use its approved correction process; establish any earlier external outcome under PCN-09 first.
identity_data.proposed_customer_message_en: Check the business identity identified in the result.

address_data.label: Address details
address_data.responsible_role: Customer/accountant; Integration if source facts are correct
address_data.proposed_next_action: Check the reported address, country, postal code, city and province. Investigate mapping if source facts are correct.
address_data.repeat_condition: After an authorised correction and revalidation. For an issued invoice, use its approved correction process; establish any earlier external outcome under PCN-09 first.
address_data.proposed_customer_message_en: Check the address details identified in the result.

profile_codes.label: Profile, codes and representation
profile_codes.responsible_role: Integration and Format; Customer/accountant only for incorrect source facts
profile_codes.proposed_next_action: Check the selected Spain profile, schemes, code lists and representation mapping. Do not replace a correct business fact to satisfy an unqualified rule.
profile_codes.repeat_condition: After an authorised correction and revalidation. For an issued invoice, use its approved correction process; establish any earlier external outcome under PCN-09 first.
profile_codes.proposed_customer_message_en: The invoice format or a required code needs review.

authority.label: Permission and representation
authority.responsible_role: Administrator/Support with Identity, Security and Compliance
authority.proposed_next_action: Check the caller, certificate, represented business and permission for the requested action. Keep correct invoice facts unchanged. A denied read must not disclose invoice existence.
authority.repeat_condition: After the technical cause is resolved, PCN-09 must establish the original outcome and the qualified operation contract must permit another attempt.
authority.proposed_customer_message_en: Ask your administrator to check permission for this action.

event_data.label: Invoice-event details
event_data.responsible_role: Customer/accountant or Lifecycle owner; Integration for mapping
event_data.proposed_next_action: Check the event-specific dates, reason and referenced invoice identity. Apply the qualified event contract; preserve the payment, collection or rejection fact.
event_data.repeat_condition: After an authorised correction and revalidation. For an issued invoice, use its approved correction process; establish any earlier external outcome under PCN-09 first.
event_data.proposed_customer_message_en: Check the details of the invoice update.

event_state.label: Repeated or incompatible action
event_state.proposed_next_action: Read and reconcile the existing report/action before deciding whether a correction or cancellation is permitted. Do not create a buyer decision or change a payment fact from this error.
event_state.repeat_condition: After the technical cause is resolved, PCN-09 must establish the original outcome and the qualified operation contract must permit another attempt.
event_state.proposed_customer_message_en: The action conflicts with an earlier invoice update. Its current result needs review.

invoice_reference.label: Invoice reference or locator
invoice_reference.proposed_next_action: Check the exact invoice identity or locator, customer scope and action authority. Distinguish an invalid reference, an invoice not found and a failed lookup; do not infer their equivalence.
invoice_reference.repeat_condition: After the technical cause is resolved, PCN-09 must establish the original outcome and the qualified operation contract must permit another attempt.
invoice_reference.proposed_customer_message_en: The invoice reference could not be used. Check the reference and access permission.

xml_structure.label: XML and document structure
xml_structure.responsible_role: Integration and Format; product developer if the supplied file is invalid
xml_structure.proposed_next_action: Inspect parsing/schema diagnostics and the selected document type. For generated XML, investigate generation or DTS mapping first. Do not ask the customer to edit issued XML.
xml_structure.repeat_condition: After the technical cause is resolved, PCN-09 must establish the original outcome and the qualified operation contract must permit another attempt.
xml_structure.proposed_customer_message_en: The document format could not be processed. Contact support with the reference.

message_packaging.label: SOAP, MIME and attachments
message_packaging.proposed_next_action: Check SOAP 1.2, MIME root, attachment types/counts, cid/Content-ID matching and message structure against the selected operation. Invoice-embedded files are a separate country rule.
message_packaging.repeat_condition: After the technical cause is resolved, PCN-09 must establish the original outcome and the qualified operation contract must permit another attempt.
message_packaging.proposed_customer_message_en: A communication-format issue prevented processing. Contact support with the reference.

message_identity.label: Message identity and certificate
message_identity.proposed_next_action: Check ebMS sender/receiver identity, roles and certificate binding. The authenticated-caller identity must not replace the invoice party identity.
message_identity.repeat_condition: After the technical cause is resolved, PCN-09 must establish the original outcome and the qualified operation contract must permit another attempt.
message_identity.proposed_customer_message_en: The communication identity needs review by your administrator or support.

message_contract.label: Operation and message contract
message_contract.proposed_next_action: Check the requested operation, service, action, environment and qualified contract. Do not switch route or use a different business action to bypass the failure.
message_contract.repeat_condition: After the technical cause is resolved, PCN-09 must establish the original outcome and the qualified operation contract must permit another attempt.
message_contract.proposed_customer_message_en: The requested operation or its communication settings need review.

query_filters.label: Query and continuation fields
query_filters.responsible_role: Product developer and Retrieval owner with Integration
query_filters.proposed_next_action: Check operation-specific filter names, role, dates, period, year and continuation. Preserve source case/spelling; do not resolve known contract conflicts from an error template alone.
query_filters.repeat_condition: After the technical cause is resolved, PCN-09 must establish the original outcome and the qualified operation contract must permit another attempt.
query_filters.proposed_customer_message_en: The search details could not be used. Review the search or contact support.

request_limits.label: Request limits and temporary access block
request_limits.proposed_next_action: Check the action-specific size/count limit or validator access block. Do not guess numeric limits, a reset time or a retry interval. A temporary block requires access recovery evidence.
request_limits.repeat_condition: After the technical cause is resolved, PCN-09 must establish the original outcome and the qualified operation contract must permit another attempt.
request_limits.proposed_customer_message_en: A request limit or temporary access restriction needs review. Contact support.

environment.label: Service unavailable in selected environment
environment.proposed_next_action: Check whether the selected service exists in this environment. Do not retry an unavailable production service, switch environment or treat PRE success as production support.
environment.repeat_condition: Only after the service/environment is qualified and enabled; apply PCN-09 for any earlier uncertain attempt.
environment.proposed_customer_message_en: This operation is not available in the selected environment.

platform_processing.label: Platform processing failure
platform_processing.responsible_role: Operations and Integration; AEAT liaison when required
platform_processing.proposed_next_action: Preserve the request and failure evidence. Investigate platform processing and establish the original external effect. Do not label correct invoice data as invalid.
platform_processing.repeat_condition: After the technical cause is resolved, PCN-09 must establish the original outcome and the qualified operation contract must permit another attempt.
platform_processing.proposed_customer_message_en: The platform could not complete processing. Its outcome needs checking.

response_processing.label: Response creation failure
response_processing.proposed_next_action: The response failed during creation or serialisation. Preserve the attempt and reconcile any possible external effect before repeating a mutation.
response_processing.repeat_condition: After the technical cause is resolved, PCN-09 must establish the original outcome and the qualified operation contract must permit another attempt.
response_processing.proposed_customer_message_en: The platform response could not be completed. We need to check the original outcome.

check_undetermined.label: Validation or lookup could not be established
check_undetermined.responsible_role: Integration and the relevant Validation/Identity owner
check_undetermined.proposed_next_action: Establish whether the check ran and whether it failed technically. Retain an undetermined result; do not treat a check failure or unmet evaluation preconditions as valid or invalid business data.
check_undetermined.repeat_condition: After the technical cause is resolved, PCN-09 must establish the original outcome and the qualified operation contract must permit another attempt.
check_undetermined.proposed_customer_message_en: The check could not establish a result. Contact support with the reference.

diagnostic_context.label: Diagnostic context or message fragment
diagnostic_context.proposed_next_action: Keep the fragment with its enclosing error and parameters. Obtain the failed rule, field and operation before selecting customer wording or recovery.
diagnostic_context.repeat_condition: No standalone repeat decision; use the enclosing qualified result and PCN-09.
diagnostic_context.proposed_customer_message_en: The result needs further review. Contact support with the reference.

source_review.label: Conflicting or malformed source entry
source_review.proposed_next_action: Preserve every original definition and occurrence. Resolve the source conflict before using this entry as a runtime lookup or selecting customer wording.
source_review.repeat_condition: No repeat decision from this entry; preserve the original outcome and apply PCN-09.
source_review.proposed_customer_message_en: The external result needs review by support.
